title: Leaning on the Everlasting Arms
lyrics_original: Safe and secure from all alarms;
Safe and secure from all alarms;
Safe and secure from all alarms;

bible_verses.english: The eternal God is your dwelling place, and underneath are the everlasting arms. He thrust out the enemy from before you; He said, ‘Destroy!’
He who dwells in the secret place of the Most High will rest in the shadow of the Almighty. I will say of Yahweh, “He is my refuge and my fortress; my God, in whom I trust.”

In nothing be anxious, but in everything, by prayer and petition with thanksgiving, let your requests be made known to God. And the peace of God, which surpasses all understanding, will guard your hearts and your thoughts in Christ Jesus.

devotional.prayer_english: Lord Jesus, thank You for being my steady refuge and constant source of peace. Forgive me for the times I try to carry my burdens alone instead of bringing them to You. Teach me to surrender my fears and lean fully on Your everlasting strength today. In Your safe embrace, I find quiet confidence and everlasting joy. Amen.
devotional.prayer_original: Lord Jesus, thank You for being my steady refuge and constant source of peace. Forgive me for the times I try to carry my burdens alone instead of bringing them to You. Teach me to surrender my fears and lean fully on Your everlasting strength today. In Your safe embrace, I find quiet confidence and everlasting joy. Amen.
devotional.reflection_english: Life often pressures us to rely on our own strength, leaving us exhausted and anxious. Yet this beloved hymn gently reminds us that we are held by an eternal, unchanging Heavenly Father whose strength never fails. When we lean into His presence, our worries fade into a divine joy and deep peace that surpasses understanding. Today, let go of the need to carry it all yourself, and rest securely in the safe embrace of your Savior’s everlasting arms.
